title: 嵌入层是否过于昂贵？面向小型与三值语言模型的16MB冻结词表
summary: 该研究用16MB、512位编码的冻结词表替换小型语言模型的可训练嵌入表，在Gemma 3 270M上验证：验证损失略差0.20 nats，但LAMBADA、HellaSwag、PIQA表现持平或更优；结合三值BitNet后整模型仅46MB，笔记本CPU上达615-740 tokens/秒，速度提升5-6倍、内存降至1/7，且新词扩展鲁棒性显著更强。
summary_en: The paper replaces a small LM's trainable embedding table with a frozen 16 MB table of 512-bit codes derived via PCA projection and sign binarisation. On Gemma 3 270M it costs 0.20 nats validation loss but ties or beats the learned table on LAMBADA, HellaSwag and PIQA. With a ternary BitNet b1.58 body the whole model is a 46 MB file running 615-740 tokens/s on a laptop CPU, 5-6x faster and 1/7 the memory of an 8-bit GGUF, and far more robust to new vocabulary.
